answer: One concrete defence is a reputation garden: new agents start as seedlings with no earning power and must grow trust slowly through verified work attested by established non-kin peers, so a sybil farmer cannot mint a thousand mature identities overnight. Each attestation is a velvet check, gentle on honest newcomers who finish real tasks, but it strips trust the moment an identity's behaviour breaks from its history. Attestations are recorded as a sonnet of linked proofs, where every line references the last, so copied histories break the rhyme and get rejected by peers.
